battles.needsKey: No battles yet. Play one, or sign in to load the battles on your account.
battles.samplesMissing: No match dynamics for this battle. Samples are kept for 180 days.

account.fuseCarryover: Used HEAT Stats on FUSE before {date}? Sign in with those same details.
account.recoveryBody: We will email you an eight-digit code that lets you set a new password.
account.resetCodeBody: Enter the eight-digit code we sent to {email}. It expires in one hour.
account.confirmBody: Enter the code we sent to {email}.
account.localBody: Your battles are recorded and kept on this PC. Sign in whenever you want them synced - nothing recorded so far is lost.
account.apiAccessHint: Lets others read your stats through the HEAT Stats API.
account.deleteHint: Removes your account and every battle uploaded to it. Battles on this PC stay.
account.legalPrefix: Creating an account means you're okay with our
account.legalRead: By using HEAT Stats you accept our
account.signOutHint: Battles on this PC stay, and upload again next time you sign in.
account.thisPcBody: Everything HEAT Stats has recorded or downloaded onto this machine.
account.pitchBody: Every battle is recorded to this PC either way. An account is what puts them somewhere they can be ranked, compared and recognised.
account.pitchPending: {count} of them have never left this machine.
account.pitchNothingYet: Play a battle and it lands here.
account.pitchFree: Free. No analytics, no crash reports, nothing sent while signed out.
account.soonBoardsBody: Where you actually stand against everyone else playing.
account.soonEventsBody: Seasonal runs with boards and standings of their own.
account.soonRatingBody: One public number for your record, earned over time.
account.soonLoadoutsBody: What the players at the top of the board actually run.
account.soonPresenceBody: HEAT Stats players are marked in game, so your name travels.
account.nowApi: Public API, if you want it

config.languageTip: Language for HEAT Stats. Automatic follows the FUSE App.
config.showWindowTip: Show the HEAT Stats window. Its close button turns this off.
config.streakLengthTip: How many recent battles the win streak strip shows.
config.playerTip: The name shown on your stats. Leave it empty to use the one from the game.
config.summaryHoldTip: How long the summary shows before uploading. Double-click to reset.
config.renderSizeTip: Canvas size. Rive overlays can't be resized on the stage, so this is how to scale them.
config.tagsHint: The colour each group is drawn in, in the game and in this window.
config.widgetsHint: Overlays that let you monitor your performance in matches
config.blockHint: Tag a player as Blocked to stop PLAY while that player can be in the same matchmaking queue.
config.blockResumeTip: After HS Block stops PLAY, the queue starts when every blocked player is in a match or offline.

block.title: HS BLOCK
block.stopped: Queue stopped. A blocked player can be in this queue.
block.override: Press PLAY again to queue anyway.
block.waiting: The queue starts when they start a match or go offline.

charts.empty: No battles recorded yet. Charts appear once you have played.
charts.railLead: Every chart measures you against your own record.
charts.railHint: Point at a chart to bring it forward
charts.tooThin: Only {count} battles - too few to read
charts.formCaption: Win rate over the last {window} battles. Your career average is {rate}.
charts.formThin: Play {window} battles and your form line starts here.
charts.strengthCaption: Win rate against your own {rate}. Only what you have played at least 10 times.
charts.strengthTip: {rate} win rate, {delta} vs your average, {count} battles
charts.gridCaption: Win rate for each pairing. Empty cells are under 5 battles.
charts.conversionCaption: Does a big game become a win? Each point is one battle.
charts.clockCaption: Win rate by the hour you started, against your own average.
charts.clockThin: Not enough battles at any one hour yet.
charts.sessionCaption: How a sitting goes: first battle, second, and on. A break over 30 minutes starts a new one.
charts.sessionThin: Not enough battles in a sitting yet.

tags.title: Tags
tags.drawnNote: First {count} marks reach the in-battle scoreboard
tags.empty: No tagged players yet. Tag someone from the postmatch scoreboard in the game.
tags.newSlot: New mark in slot {n}: pick a group
tags.taken: This player already has this mark
tags.blockedBeta: HS Block is in beta. It stops PLAY while a blocked player can be in your queue. It can miss a player.
tags.clear: Remove every mark for this player

reset.battleTip: One reading for the whole battle.

scene.aliveTip: While you drive, aim or use an ability.
scene.mapTip: While the tactical map is open.
scene.deadTip: From the fatal hit until the deploy screen.
scene.deployTip: On the deploy screen and during the spawn drop.
scene.resultsTip: After the match ends, on the results screens.

replays.title: Replays
replays.lead: HEAT keeps only your 10 newest replays. Press Keep to save a copy that stays.
replays.controls: Replay controls: Space pauses and resumes. Right arrow speeds up. Left arrow returns to normal speed.
replays.noAccess: HEAT Stats needs the Game files permission to read your replays. Allow it in the FUSE App.
replays.empty: No replays yet. HEAT writes one at the end of each battle.
replays.noPlay: Allow Start programs for HEAT Stats in the FUSE App to play replays.
replays.keptOnlyTip: The game deleted its copy. HEAT Stats has the only one.
replays.oldTip: Recorded on {branch}. No installed game has this build, so the replay cannot play.
replays.unknownTip: The file does not name its build. A black screen means a different build.
replays.writingTip: The game still writes this replay.

notice.missing: This replay is gone. HEAT keeps only the 10 newest.
notice.noPlay: HEAT Stats needs the Start programs permission to play replays.
notice.oldBuild: No installed game has the build this replay needs.
notice.noGame: No game folder found. Set it in the FUSE App.
notice.startFailed: The game did not start. The HEAT Stats log has the reason.
notice.keepFailed: The copy failed. The HEAT Stats log has the reason.
